pay_hardtostaff_sped_009.evidence: Teachers who teach in Intensive Support Programs (ISP), Behavior Intervention Programs (BIP) and Autism Specific Programs (Self-contained, full-day, as defined by the District Special Education Department) shall be paid five one-hundredths (.05) of the individual teacher’s contracted salary.

pay_hardtostaff_other_011.evidence: Teachers who possess a current Bilingual and/or ESL endorsement shall receive a differential of $500 effective the beginning of the school year... Additional $2,500.00 for providing TESOL services only.
